reason: N1 (docs/native-dynamics-plan.md): a second, higher-degree gravity golden beyond leo_1day_jgm2_8x8's JGM2 8x8, to pin the native spherical-harmonic recursion at the degree/order (70x70) crates/av-orbital claims stability to; same central body, spacecraft ballistic set and epoch as the JGM2 goldens, no third bodies or other forces, six hours (not one day, EGM96 70x70 being expensive per the N1 cost note). Regenerated by the native-dynamics manager (round 1 review) for one reason only: the tolerance first recorded here was gen_leo_1day.py's inherited 0.05 m default, which pinned nothing, while crates/av-orbital/tests/gravity_goldens.rs held the native model to the MEASURED 5e-4 m. ADR-002's goldens rule requires the tolerance committed with the golden to be the tolerance in force, so it is now the measured one: the native EarthGravityModel (EGM96 70x70, GMAT-validated body-fixed rotation, Dopri5 rtol=atol=1e-12) reproduces this arc's final state to 2.742649e-4 m and 3.043023e-7 m/s over 21600 s; the native acceleration agrees with GMAT's own GetDerivatives to 3.32e-14 m/s^2 (3.92e-15 relative) over four epochs, so the residual is integrator-family disagreement, not a force-model difference. The GMAT-side state is unchanged by this regeneration.
